title: Regulatory Notice Clarification On Calculation For Insurance Covers (002)
text:
NOTICE NUMBER: SECZ05012026
CLARIFICATION ON PROFESSIONAL INDEMNITY COVER
This Notice is issued in terms of paragraph 21 of the FIRST SCHEDULE of the Securities
and Exchange Act [Chapter 24:25]. The purpose of the notice is to clarify the amount
that must be used when calculating insurable amounts in respect of professional
indemnity.
We refer to paragraph 4.1 of the Capital Adequacy Directive for Securities Market
Intermediaries (SMIs), December 2025 (Notice No. SECZ-SS1225). Kindly note that the
amount used for the purposes of professional indemnity is at the discretion of the firm.
For and on behalf of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe
Norman Maferefa
Director of Operations
